inlines.v: GRE'ASY, adjective greez'y. Oily; fat; unctuous. 1. Smeared or defiled with grease. 2. Like grease or oil; smooth; as a fossil that has a greasy feel. 3. Fat of body; bulky. [Little used.] 4. Gross; indelicate; indecent.
